story_fits.trend: Microsoft/Outlook outage (#outlook US 3, #microsoft GB 4, ZA 12, #outage US 10): the only topic in US, UK and African data
story_fits.chapter: 3 (eps 21-30), Bulawayo before Dubai; ep 25 REVELATION, pays off pages_out_window
story_fits.scene: After the watch flies out the window, the tracker app on Solo's phone is the only way to find the pages, and the whole network goes down (generic outage, no brand names). The crew walks the tracks at dawn with Clyde holding his phone up like a torch. The signal comes back for one second: the dot is moving. Someone already picked the watch up.
story_fits.lesson: Don't build your whole plan on one thing you don't control.
story_fits.rule_line: ONE APP. ONE PLAN. ZERO BARS.

story_fits.scene: A halo rings the sun over the Bulawayo tracks. Everyone films the sky; Clyde films a selfie 'with his crown' and gets only his forehead. Mtoriro sees the ring matches the circle on the lost page. In the crowd one figure films Clyde instead, a gold ring catching the light (gold_ring_follower: seen, never shown).
story_fits.lesson: Filming the moment for others makes you miss it yourself.
story_fits.rule_line: THE SKY DID A HALO. YOU DID A FOREHEAD.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'POSTING IT ANYWAY. CAPTION: I ATE.'

story_fits.trend: Christmas songs climbing on all three charts (Worldwide, US, Nigeria 'Christmas Present') + #redcupday (US 18): holiday-spending mood
story_fits.chapter: 3: showing off, lifestyle traps; good for ep 27-29 before Dubai
story_fits.scene: Before the Dubai flight, Clyde buys 'Dubai-level' gifts for the crew on credit to look rich. Ruva's gift is bigger than her. Mtoriro reads the receipt like a horror story. Solo gives a cheap pen, and it's the only gift that helps (it writes in the dark on the train). Feeds solo_trust before the ep 27 BETRAYAL.
story_fits.lesson: Gifts you can't afford are a bill you give yourself.
story_fits.rule_line: GIFTS ON CREDIT. JANUARY SAYS HI.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'RELAX, I PAID THE MINIMUM.' A card machine beeps offscreen.

story_fits.trend: Small-business founder story + entrepreneur-couple skits (trend videos 2, 3, 6: storytelling/skit formats, 21-37M views)
story_fits.scene: Stuck waiting in a Bulawayo tuck shop, Clyde decides to become a 'founder' after one video, sells 'Rule Book merch' made from napkins, and compares his zero sales to a stranger's five-years-of-work glow-up post. The tuck shop owner quietly mentions she's been open 30 years.
story_fits.lesson: You're comparing your day 1 to their year 5.
story_fits.rule_line: THEIR YEAR 5. YOUR DAY 1. YOUR NAPKIN.

story_fits.scene: Clyde blames Friday the 13th for losing the pages: the black cat, the ladder, the 'cursed' watch. Cenzo lists the real causes: he wore a tracker for a flex and threw it out a window. The cat walks off unbothered.
story_fits.lesson: Bad luck is usually a choice you made earlier.
story_fits.rule_line: IT WASN'T THE DATE. IT WAS THE WATCH.
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'FINE. BUT THE CAT KNOWS SOMETHING.'
